title: The Forty Springs of Arba Minch
logline: From behind a glowing computer screen late at night, a developer is transported back to the emerald forests and forty springs of Arba Minch, where four boys risked their mothers' scoldings for one afternoon of heaven.
treatment: Sitting at a cluttered work desk in the quiet of the night, the narrator remembers childhood in Arba Minch. Looking out from the hill above the town, the ancient groundwater forest appears like paradise between the great lakes. Four young boys—the narrator, his brother Mikiyas, and inseparable friends Mihretab and Surafel—sneak out past their mothers' watch to plunge into the secret natural spring pool. The memory of pure water, towering fig trees, and unbroken brotherhood proves that paradise was never lost; it remains the foundation of who they are today.
